en: Oh, help! Please, you must help me! A ruffian in a striped shirt snatched my dear Peeko!
He ran into the tunnel with her, and my old legs can't keep up. My poor little Wingull...
My girlfriend Wanda lives in Verdanturf, on the far side of the hill. If only the tunnel went all the way through!
Some fellow in a striped shirt just shoved past me and ran into the tunnel. What's the hurry?
That ruffian came running back out of the tunnel and fled. Good riddance, I say!
Oh, it's you! Thank you again for your help. Please, take one of our newest Poké Balls.
A Repeat Ball works best on Pokémon you've caught before. Devon's latest invention!
